Dressed for the Mountains

Bear Monkeys · Horton Plains National Park, Sri Lanka

High on top of Sri Lanka's mountains lies Horton Plains National Park, a place where the air stays cool all year round. And living in those chilly heights is a monkey you will find nowhere else on Earth: the bear monkey.

Bear monkeys are endemic to Sri Lanka, and they are made for the mountains. To keep warm in the cold, they wear a thick, shaggy coat of fur, which is how they earned their name.

They are also very hard to find. Spotting a bear monkey takes luck, and spotting a baby is even rarer.

On this day, luck was with us. As we travelled along the road, we spotted two of them sitting at the top of a tree, right beside the road and remarkably close to us. One of them was a baby.

The baby was so cute that I didn't wait a single second. I lifted my camera and took this picture the moment I saw them.
